mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_log_${l.deviceId}_${l.tableDate} USING device_log TAGS (#{l.deviceId}, #{l.productKey}, #{l.deviceName}) VALUES (#{l.ts}, #{l.logType}, #{l.content}, #{l.messageId})
mapper.select: SELECT ts, log_type, content, message_id FROM device_log WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND log_type = 'event' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT #{limit}
